title: Identification of the canonical isomorphism transfer by its inverse formula
statement: Let P, Q, Z be quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes, e:P≅Q an isomorphism and p:P→Z, q:Q→Z quasi-compact quasi-separated maps with e.hom≫q=p. Supply a transfer k equal to the following explicit construction: construct the transfer from pinned direct-image composition, right-adjoint uniqueness and the equivalence unit [lem-sc-horizontal-duality-mate-comparisons]. If j:L(e.hom)⋙R(p)≅R(q) has inverse whose ambient component equals R(q) applied to the pinned unit for e.hom, followed by the inverse conjugate of the composition comparison and the equality transport [def-pc-derived-base-change-map, lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition], then k’s component equals j.hom at every object. This statement contains no base-change map, no iterated rectangle, and no chain of base morphisms.

source.place: Lemma 20.27.2 (0D5S), Lemma 20.28.2 (0D5T), Remark 20.28.3 (08HY); uniqueness and unit compatibility of adjoints

proof.text: Substitute p using hp and k using its defining equality. Prove generic restriction formulas for the adjunction unit and counit on full subcategories. Expand the hom of horizontalMatePushComp and the ambient conjugate using conjugateEquiv_apply_app and comp_unit_app. The restriction formulas and the definition of horizontalMateLiftIso identify their ambient components.

Compose the supplied j.inv component with the constructed transfer. The restricted conjugate inverse and hom cancel. The remaining composite is R(q) applied to the pinned unit at D, ri.hom at L(D), and ev.unitIso.inv at D. By unit_rightAdjointUniq_hom_app the first two factors are ev.unitIso.hom at D, so functoriality and inverse cancellation give the identity. Reflect through the faithful inclusion and precompose with j.hom to prove the required equality. This applies to identity arrows, empty schemes and zero objects.

theorem horizontal_transfer_eq_of_inverse_formula
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    {P Q Z : Scheme.{u}}
    [CompactSpace P] [QuasiSeparatedSpace P] [CompactSpace Q] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Q]
    [CompactSpace Z] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Z]
    (e : P ≅ Q) (q : Q ⟶ Z) (p : P ⟶ Z)
    [QuasiCompact q] [QuasiSeparated q] [QuasiCompact p] [QuasiSeparated p]
    (hp : e.hom ≫ q = p) :
    let ev := horizontalMateEquivalence e
    let ri := (horizontalMateAdjunction e.hom).rightAdjointUniq ev.toAdjunction
    let li := eqToIso (congrArg qcDirectImage hp.symm) ≪≫
      horizontalMatePushComp e.hom q ≪≫
      Functor.isoWhiskerRight ri (horizontalMatePushforward q)
    let k₀ : TwoSquare (horizontalMatePullback e.hom) (horizontalMatePushforward q)
        (horizontalMatePushforward p) (𝟭 (schemeDerivedQCohCategory Z)) :=
      .mk _ _ _ _ <|
        (Functor.isoWhiskerLeft (horizontalMatePullback e.hom) li).hom ≫
          (Functor.associator _ _ _).inv ≫
          Functor.whiskerRight ev.unitIso.inv (horizontalMatePushforward q) ≫
          (Functor.leftUnitor (horizontalMatePushforward q)).hom ≫
          (Functor.rightUnitor (horizontalMatePushforward q)).inv
    let a := fun {A B : Scheme.{u}} (r : A ⟶ B) ↦
      Classical.choose (exists_schemeDerivedAdjunction r
        (hAdd := (Classical.choose exists_derivedPullbackComposition) r)
        ((Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec exists_derivedPullbackComposition)) r)
        ((Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec
          (Classical.choose_spec exists_derivedPullbackComposition))) r))
    let d := conjugateIsoEquiv (a p) ((a q).comp (a e.hom))
      (horizontalMateAmbientComp e.hom q ≪≫
        eqToIso (congrArg (fun r ↦ derivedPullback.{u, w} r) hp))
    ∀ (k : TwoSquare (horizontalMatePullback e.hom) (horizontalMatePushforward q)
        (horizontalMatePushforward p) (𝟭 (schemeDerivedQCohCategory Z))), k = k₀ →
    ∀ (j : qcPullback e.hom ⋙ qcDirectImage p ≅ qcDirectImage q),
      (∀ D : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Q,
        (schemeDerivedQCohProperty Z).ι.map (j.inv.app D) =
          (schemeDerivedDirectImage q).map ((a e.hom).unit.app D.obj) ≫
            d.inv.app ((derivedPullback e.hom).obj D.obj)) →
      ∀ D : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Q, k.app D = j.hom.app D
